1879064257.name: Call to the Valar
1879064257.desc:
You call upon the wisdom of the Valar, recovering some of your skills and providing a temporary immunity to induction set back from damage.

<rgb=#33BCFF>Keeper of Animals:</rgb> Retribution, Catmint, Unbreakable Bond

<rgb=#FF0000>Master of Nature's Fury:</rgb> Sticky Gourd, Lightning Storm, Ents go to War

<rgb=#ecdd11>Ancient Master:</rgb> Storm Lore, Test of Will, Air Lore

1879064385.name: Guide to Thorin's Hall
1879064385.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Thorin's Hall.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879089857.name: Return to Camp
1879089857.desc: Binds you to one of many camp-sites scattered across the world.\n\nBinding enables you to return to the camp-site with ease.

1879093057.name: Peck
1879093057.desc: You peck at something with your beak.

1879116097.name: Precise Blow
1879116097.desc: A quick attack which deals Light Damage over time.

1879136961.name: Mutilation
1879136961.desc: A spinning cut that can damage and wound multiple targets around you.

1879139393.name: Warding Blow
1879139393.desc: Your great skill enables you to strengthen your defences for a short time.

1879180353.name: Return to Ost Guruth
1879180353.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Eglain people in the Lone-lands, you are able to quickly return to their homestead at Ost Guruth.

1879210817.name: Skirmisher: Tangleshot
1879210817.desc: When a target's movement speed is slowed, this bow-attack deals extreme damage.

1879212097.name: Pile of Fluffy Snow
1879212097.desc: A pile of very fine, very fluffy snow that... doesn't melt?

1879213889.name: Surgical Strike (Tactical)
1879213889.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215041.name: Map to Gramsfoot
1879215041.desc: A map detailing the lay of the land leading to Gramsfoot.

1879230273.name: Brute
1879230273.desc: Your brute strength strikes fear into the hearts of your enemies.

1879233857.name: War-steed: Medium
1879233857.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or maneuverability.

1879241409.name: Call of Eärendil
1879241409.desc: Resonance must be active to use this skill. Your words reflect upon the strength and glory of Eärendil, dealing AoE Light Damage and reducing the enemy's Light damage resistance.

1879242305.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879242305.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline allows the Lore-master to focus on Beast-lore, turning their attention to the weakening or enhancement of beasts.

1879244865.name: Strike with Power
1879244865.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, dealing damage and increasing threat against the target.

1879248321.name: Ballad - Dirge
1879248321.desc: Through the use of a dirge one can speak of the past glories of a fallen warrior and drain the very heart out of an enemy.

1879267905.name: Song of Unity
1879267905.desc: The Minstrel sings a song that allows them to instantly reap the benefit of two ballads and unlock their Coda

1879268545.name: Lingering Wound
1879268545.desc: Arrows leave a lingering wound that tiers up with repeated use.

1879272129.name: Born For Combat
1879272129.desc: Make a full AoE attack, gaining a Damage bonus for each enemy hit.

1879302593.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Lossoth)
1879302593.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879324225.name: Steed of New Bloom
1879324225.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879344577.name: Crimson Dragon Kite
1879344577.desc: Brings out a crimson dragon kite for you to fly!

1879411393.name: Low Strike
1879411393.desc: A swift punch that generates Mettle.\n\nLow Set-up: If Low Strike is the most recent Set-up Attack used, the next damaging Mettle-spender will restore a substantial amount of Power.

1879411777.name: Mighty Upheaval
1879411777.desc: You slam your gauntlets into the ground with incredible force, creating a shockwave to damage and possibly knock opponents down.

1879414209.name: Goat of Winter Cheer
1879414209.desc: A Goat steed, perfect for delivering gifts to the farthest corners of Middle-earth.

1879452481.name: Valiant Steed of the Dúnedain
1879452481.desc: A steed that answers the call of battle with fire and fury.

1879456449.name: Execute (Dual)
1879456449.desc: A devastating attack against a single enemy. Consumes all your Wrath.

1879459393.name: Test Magic Tactical VPS
1879459393.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879466433.name: Bastion of Light
1879466433.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879476161.name: Sail to Dol Amroth, King's Gondor
1879476161.desc: Navigate to Dol Amroth in King's Gondor with nearby fellows.

1879484865.name: Return to Bej Mâgha
1879484865.desc: You're able to quickly return to the fishing village of Bej Mâgha on the Cape of Umbar. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879485249.name: Steed of the Green Dragon Inn

1879506625.name: Lava Spout
1879506625.desc: Target the earth and draw forth a fumarole of burning lava.

1879516865.name: Baby Camel
1879516865.desc: Summons a cute baby camel to accompany you on your travels.

1879522625.name: Perfect Ballad - Melody
1879522625.desc: Heals you and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.
